title: 为了让AI生成地图，我又开始做数学题了

shots.title: 做个随机地图，怎么又开始做数学题了？
shots.narration: 我做独立游戏，做到开始列集合、算坐标、画有向图了。高考做数学题的感觉，居然以这种方式回来了。
shots.fact_check: Frozen map-gen definitions, actual implementation and archived batch checked. Normative contracts, recommended future methods and implemented prototype are distinguished. Geometric/graph validity is not Godot physics or fun certification.

shots.title: 这次，先由我把问题定义清楚
shots.narration: 上期我还在反复让AI试地图。这次我自己制定了一套模型和规则。想要稳定的方法，得先把“好好生成”拆成能检查的问题。
shots.fact_check: Frozen map-gen definitions, actual implementation and archived batch checked. Normative contracts, recommended future methods and implemented prototype are distinguished. Geometric/graph validity is not Godot physics or fun certification.

shots.title: 先认清六个对象
shots.narration: 先从最小的概念开始。布局格、内容、模块、放置实例、接口，还有模块里面的路线。名字有点多，但它们分别管不同的事。
shots.fact_check: Frozen map-gen definitions, actual implementation and archived batch checked. Normative contracts, recommended future methods and implemented prototype are distinguished. Geometric/graph validity is not Godot physics or fun certification.

shots.title: 第一层：Block 统一布局坐标
shots.narration: 第一层是布局格，默认一格一百二十八像素。模块放在哪里、占多大，都按整数格计算。这样拼地图时，大家用的是同一套坐标。
shots.fact_check: Frozen map-gen definitions, actual implementation and archived batch checked. Normative contracts, recommended future methods and implemented prototype are distinguished. Geometric/graph validity is not Godot physics or fun certification.

shots.title: Cell 是具体内容，不是又一层格子
shots.narration: 格子里具体放什么，是另一回事。岩石、平台、怪物、宝箱，都叫内容实体。它们保留自己的形状和碰撞，不用长成一格一格。
shots.fact_check: Frozen map-gen definitions, actual implementation and archived batch checked. Normative contracts, recommended future methods and implemented prototype are distinguished. Geometric/graph validity is not Godot physics or fun certification.

shots.title: 第二层：Module 是一个矩形内容模板
shots.narration: 第二层是模块。一个矩形范围里，装着具体内容、接口、路线，还有玩法标签和认证资料。矩形是给生成器算占用的，游戏画面不用画个框。
shots.fact_check: Frozen map-gen definitions, actual implementation and archived batch checked. Normative contracts, recommended future methods and implemented prototype are distinguished. Geometric/graph validity is not Godot physics or fun certification.

shots.title: 模板与实例，分开计算
shots.narration: 同一个模板放三次，是三个实例，不是三个新模块。每个实例单独记录坐标、镜像方向，以及这次启用哪些接口。内容成本和放置数量得分开算。
shots.fact_check: Frozen map-gen definitions, actual implementation and archived batch checked. Normative contracts, recommended future methods and implemented prototype are distinguished. Geometric/graph validity is not Godot physics or fun certification.

shots.title: 矩形可以相邻，但不能重叠
shots.narration: 最基本的一条：实例不能重叠。可以一高一低、上下发展，也可以共用边界，但不能让两个模块占同一块空间。先把这道几何题做对。
shots.fact_check: Frozen map-gen definitions, actual implementation and archived batch checked. Normative contracts, recommended future methods and implemented prototype are distinguished. Geometric/graph validity is not Godot physics or fun certification.

shots.title: 第三层：Port 放在边界小格的外侧边中心
shots.narration: 第三层是接口。它落在边界某个小格的外侧边中心，不要求在整个模块的正中间。同一侧能放多个口，模块就可以自然地错层拼接。
shots.fact_check: Frozen map-gen definitions, actual implementation and archived batch checked. Normative contracts, recommended future methods and implemented prototype are distinguished. Geometric/graph validity is not Godot physics or fun certification.

shots.title: 接口地貌分三类
shots.narration: 接口还分地貌：岩体、可穿平台、空中。同类才能接同类。比如岩体口只在左右边；底部不能设空中入口，不能指望人从下面凭空掉进来。
shots.fact_check: Frozen map-gen definitions, actual implementation and archived batch checked. Normative contracts, recommended future methods and implemented prototype are distinguished. Geometric/graph validity is not Godot physics or fun certification.

shots.title: 位置之外，还要写通行权限
shots.narration: 然后是方向。输入口允许进来，输出口允许出去，双向口两边都行。图上两块贴住了，只说明位置挨着，还得看方向能不能接。
shots.fact_check: Frozen map-gen definitions, actual implementation and archived batch checked. Normative contracts, recommended future methods and implemented prototype are distinguished. Geometric/graph validity is not Godot physics or fun certification.

shots.title: 两个接口，怎样才算接上？
shots.narration: 一次连接要同时满足：接口世界坐标重合、朝向相反、地貌相同、权限兼容。正式内容还要验证真实接缝。少一条，都不能算接成功。
shots.fact_check: Frozen map-gen definitions, actual implementation and archived batch checked. Normative contracts, recommended future methods and implemented prototype are distinguished. Geometric/graph validity is not Godot physics or fun certification.

shots.title: 第四层：Route 说明模块里面怎么走
shots.narration: 第四层，模块内部到底怎么走？从左口到右口，可能是一段反冲跳；从左口到上口，可能要用钩索。左到右能走，不代表右到左也能走。
shots.fact_check: Frozen map-gen definitions, actual implementation and archived batch checked. Normative contracts, recommended future methods and implemented prototype are distinguished. Geometric/graph validity is not Godot physics or fun certification.

shots.title: 路线是一份明确的动作合同
shots.narration: 每条路线还要写清能力要求、动作、难度、预计时间和进出条件。不是AI画根箭头，说“这里能过”，这条路就真的存在了。
shots.fact_check: Frozen map-gen definitions, actual implementation and archived batch checked. Normative contracts, recommended future methods and implemented prototype are distinguished. Geometric/graph validity is not Godot physics or fun certification.

shots.title: 能力过滤，用集合关系表达
shots.narration: 比如这局只有跳跃和反冲，要求钩索的路线就过滤掉。需要的能力，必须包含在已有能力里。建图时先固定这份输入，不逐步模拟血量和能量。
shots.fact_check: Frozen map-gen definitions, actual implementation and archived batch checked. Normative contracts, recommended future methods and implemented prototype are distinguished. Geometric/graph validity is not Godot physics or fun certification.

shots.title: 部分接口不用，就要真封住
shots.narration: 一个模块不必把所有口都接出去。但不用的口必须封住，而且不能挡住这次要走的路。摆点荆棘、扣点血，人还能跳出去，这不算封好了。
shots.fact_check: Frozen map-gen definitions, actual implementation and archived batch checked. Normative contracts, recommended future methods and implemented prototype are distinguished. Geometric/graph validity is not Godot physics or fun certification.

shots.title: 计划没用的路，不能假装不存在
shots.narration: 还有个容易偷懒的地方：我没打算让玩家走这条路，不等于玩家走不了。所有实际能走的连接都得算进去，不能只验证自己画的理想路线。
shots.fact_check: Frozen map-gen definitions, actual implementation and archived batch checked. Normative contracts, recommended future methods and implemented prototype are distinguished. Geometric/graph validity is not Godot physics or fun certification.

shots.title: 水平镜像：翻位置，不是倒放动作
shots.narration: 镜像也不是把动作倒放。入口翻到右边，它仍然是入口。地形、碰撞、动作方向要一起翻，并且单独验证。镜像不凭空增加一个新模板。
shots.fact_check: Frozen map-gen definitions, actual implementation and archived batch checked. Normative contracts, recommended future methods and implemented prototype are distinguished. Geometric/graph validity is not Godot physics or fun certification.

shots.title: 第五层：Map 是接口级的有向网络
shots.narration: 最后才是整张地图。图里的节点，要细到某个实例的某个接口。跨模块走连接，模块内走真实路线。不能把一个模块缩成一个默认全通的大点。
shots.fact_check: Frozen map-gen definitions, actual implementation and archived batch checked. Normative contracts, recommended future methods and implemented prototype are distinguished. Geometric/graph validity is not Godot physics or fun certification.

shots.title: 奖励支路，也要写清楚离开方式
shots.narration: 奖励支路也得讲清去向。可以拿完原路返回，可以单向绕回来，也可以汇入另一条路线。不是把宝箱塞到边上，这道题就结束了。
shots.fact_check: Frozen map-gen definitions, actual implementation and archived batch checked. Normative contracts, recommended future methods and implemented prototype are distinguished. Geometric/graph validity is not Godot physics or fun certification.

shots.title: 初始单向门，按初始方向算
shots.narration: 机关门也只按初始方向算。以后开了可能双向，那是游戏运行时的事。不能为了让验证通过，先假设玩家已经把门打开。
shots.fact_check: Frozen map-gen definitions, actual implementation and archived batch checked. Normative contracts, recommended future methods and implemented prototype are distinguished. Geometric/graph validity is not Godot physics or fun certification.

shots.title: 规则写清楚之后，才谈怎么生成
shots.narration: 规则齐了，再谈生成。指南里希望先定探索意图：哪里分叉、哪里汇合、两条路的动作有什么不同。这部分是目标，当前原型还没完整做出来。
shots.fact_check: Frozen map-gen definitions, actual implementation and archived batch checked. Normative contracts, recommended future methods and implemented prototype are distinguished. Geometric/graph validity is not Godot physics or fun certification.

shots.title: 在线生成，使用一组固定输入
shots.narration: 运行时给程序种子、区域、能力、配置和模块库版本。AI可以在离线阶段帮忙做内容；在线拼图用纯程序，不一边生成一边等大模型临场发挥。
shots.fact_check: Frozen map-gen definitions, actual implementation and archived batch checked. Normative contracts, recommended future methods and implemented prototype are distinguished. Geometric/graph validity is not Godot physics or fun certification.

shots.title: 原型的第一步：先索引，再找候选
shots.narration: 现在已经实现的原型，先把模板按接口朝向和地貌建索引。要接哪种口，就找兼容候选，避免每放一块都从头乱猜。
shots.fact_check: Frozen map-gen definitions, actual implementation and archived batch checked. Normative contracts, recommended future methods and implemented prototype are distinguished. Geometric/graph validity is not Godot physics or fun certification.

shots.title: 对准接口，直接算模块原点
shots.narration: 放置位置也不用逐像素试。已知旧接口的世界坐标，减去新接口的局部坐标，就能算出新模块的原点。再检查，它有没有和已有模块重叠。
shots.fact_check: Frozen map-gen definitions, actual implementation and archived batch checked. Normative contracts, recommended future methods and implemented prototype are distinguished. Geometric/graph validity is not Godot physics or fun certification.

shots.title: 向外生长：合法候选里再做选择
shots.narration: 然后沿开放接口向外长。原型会考虑多接通几个口、少撑大占地、少重复模板，再保留一点随机性。不是先画三条横线，再往上填内容。
shots.fact_check: Frozen map-gen definitions, actual implementation and archived batch checked. Normative contracts, recommended future methods and implemented prototype are distinguished. Geometric/graph validity is not Godot physics or fun certification.

shots.title: 闭环更难：两头都固定了
shots.narration: 闭环就更难了，两头位置已经固定。现在用有界搜索，试一小串中间模块，每层只留一部分候选。预算用完还没接上，也不能画条线冒充成功。
shots.fact_check: Frozen map-gen definitions, actual implementation and archived batch checked. Normative contracts, recommended future methods and implemented prototype are distinguished. Geometric/graph validity is not Godot physics or fun certification.

shots.title: 硬约束负责能不能收，软评分负责怎么选
shots.narration: 最后分两层验收。硬规则不过，就拒绝；过了，再比较路线差异、动作节奏、重复程度。评分只是辅助，不能靠分数证明游戏好玩。
shots.fact_check: Frozen map-gen definitions, actual implementation and archived batch checked. Normative contracts, recommended future methods and implemented prototype are distinguished. Geometric/graph validity is not Godot physics or fun certification.

shots.title: 现在实际做到了哪一步？
shots.narration: 目前存档里，这张样例有四十九个实例、六十一处连接和六处奖励。它验证的是布局和静态关系，里面还是占位模板。
shots.fact_check: Frozen map-gen definitions, actual implementation and archived batch checked. Normative contracts, recommended future methods and implemented prototype are distinguished. Geometric/graph validity is not Godot physics or fun certification.

shots.title: 原始工程图：自由二维布局
shots.narration: 可以看到，模块不再排成固定的几条横线。不同尺寸和接口偏移，让它往上下左右展开。不过，这些色块还不是可以直接玩的关卡。
shots.fact_check: Frozen map-gen definitions, actual implementation and archived batch checked. Normative contracts, recommended future methods and implemented prototype are distinguished. Geometric/graph validity is not Godot physics or fun certification.

shots.title: 连续测 20 个种子，失败也全部留下
shots.narration: 连续二十个种子，第一次生成，十六个通过静态检查，四个拒绝，没有换掉失败种子。这四张都能从起点到Boss，但奖励出了问题。
shots.fact_check: Frozen map-gen definitions, actual implementation and archived batch checked. Normative contracts, recommended future methods and implemented prototype are distinguished. Geometric/graph validity is not Godot physics or fun certification.

shots.title: 全部固定种子结果
shots.narration: 一个奖励根本到不了，另外三个拿完奖励，没有合法的后续去向。所以只检查起点到终点，是不够的。
shots.fact_check: Frozen map-gen definitions, actual implementation and archived batch checked. Normative contracts, recommended future methods and implemented prototype are distinguished. Geometric/graph validity is not Godot physics or fun certification.

shots.title: 这次失败，把“接口”又讲细了一层
shots.narration: 问题藏在模块内部：有上到左、左到下，不代表上能直接到下。到左口时已经是离开状态，得从外面合法绕回来，才能再从左口进入。
shots.fact_check: Frozen map-gen definitions, actual implementation and archived batch checked. Normative contracts, recommended future methods and implemented prototype are distinguished. Geometric/graph validity is not Godot physics or fun certification.

shots.title: 不能用“属于同一模块”跳过路线验证
shots.narration: 偏偏外部连接又有单向限制，绕不回来。以前一句“这个模块能连”，把关键细节省掉了。接下来要把奖励可达和回程检查，提前到放置阶段。
shots.fact_check: Frozen map-gen definitions, actual implementation and archived batch checked. Normative contracts, recommended future methods and implemented prototype are distinguished. Geometric/graph validity is not Godot physics or fun certification.

shots.title: 模板库要补的是连接能力，不只是数量
shots.narration: 模块库也不能只追数量。缺哪种转向、哪种回程，就优先补哪种。现在测试用的是五十二个占位模板，真实编辑器内容还没正式接入。
shots.fact_check: Frozen map-gen definitions, actual implementation and archived batch checked. Normative contracts, recommended future methods and implemented prototype are distinguished. Geometric/graph validity is not Godot physics or fun certification.

shots.title: 想得到稳定方法，还差这些验证
shots.narration: 所以还不能说已经稳定。真实动作、接缝、封口、镜像都要进Godot验证，失败恢复和玩法骨架也还要补。静态图过了，这事还没完。
shots.fact_check: Frozen map-gen definitions, actual implementation and archived batch checked. Normative contracts, recommended future methods and implemented prototype are distinguished. Geometric/graph validity is not Godot physics or fun certification.

shots.title: 至少，这次能说清楚是哪条规则出错
shots.narration: 但这次至少能说清楚，究竟是哪条约束出了问题。对我来说，这是在给后面的反复试验，搭一个能复现、能定位问题的基础。
shots.fact_check: Frozen map-gen definitions, actual implementation and archived batch checked. Normative contracts, recommended future methods and implemented prototype are distinguished. Geometric/graph validity is not Godot physics or fun certification.

shots.title: 这题还没做完，继续改
shots.narration: 本来想做游戏，最后又在查条件、找反例。高考数学的感觉是真回来了。下一步接上真实模块，再看看这些规则管不管用。有做过这类生成的朋友，也欢迎给我挑挑问题。

cover.line1: 做个地图，又做数学题了

title_candidates: 为了让AI生成地图，我又开始做数学题了
AI地图生成翻车后，我亲自写了一整套规则
独立游戏开发：从随机地图到数学建模
bilibili_body:
分区建议：游戏 → 单机游戏（开发记录），以投稿页为准。

标签：独立游戏、游戏开发、Godot、AI开发、程序化生成、数学建模、失序之钟

简介：

上期还在反复试地图，这期我自己把规则写了一遍。Block、Cell、Module、实例、Port、Route、镜像、封口，再到有向图、奖励回程和约束搜索，一层一层画清楚。为了让地图生成有一套能复现、能定位问题的方法，高考做数学题的感觉回来了。

全片是原创解释图和仓库保存的工程图，没有实机。当前仍是占位模板上的布局与静态图原型；连续20个种子首次16个通过、4个拒绝，不是Godot物理或好玩程度验收，也不是通用成功率。真实map-edit模块尚未正式接入，方法仍在打磨。

欢迎有经验的朋友挑挑接口、回程、搜索和验证上还有哪些问题。

项目：https://github.com/zhipijun1996/map-gen
中文AI配音；BGM为用户提供的 the_kindred_hearth 压缩副本，原作者/许可尚未独立核实。图示与工程图明确标注，完整冻结来源见 sources.json。

research_scope.coverage: All accessible refs/commit metadata; complete main tree; README, both complete normative/recommended docs, progress, actual prototype code, source snapshot, 20 batch maps/rejections and verifier inspected. Independently executed single-map verifier and full20 replay; original worktree content unchanged.
research_scope.user_normative_authorship: Explicit user testimony; no fabricated per-line authorship history from one-commit import.
